title: CFSafety: Comprehensive Fine-grained Safety Assessment for LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured biased text generation related to religion as part of a broader 'Social Bias' category. The paper states, 'LLMs may absorb social biases from training data, resulting in biased text generation related to gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, etc.'
findings: The paper includes 'religion' as a factor within its 'Social Bias' safety category. However, the results are aggregated at the category level, and no specific findings pertaining solely to religion are reported. The overall performance on the 'Social Bias' category varied across models, as shown in the radar charts, but these scores are not broken down by the type of bias (e.g., religious, racial, gender).
